newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy Ross to meet Arafat on Hebron deal.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy Ross to meet Arafat on Hebron deal.

text.p: U.S. Middle East envoy Dennis Ross will meet Palestinian President Yasser Arafat in self-ruled Gaza late on Monday in an effort to clinch a deal on Hebron, a Palestinian official told Reuters.

"Ross will meet with Arafat at midnight (2200 GMT)," said the official who did not want to be identified. The official said a meeting between Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu would be held on Tuesday.
"The negotiators in Jerusalem will continue drafting the agreed points and the Arafat-Netanyahu meeting will take place on Tuesday," the official said.
Ross would travel to Gaza from Jerusalem where he joined Israeli and Palestinian negotiators trying to hammer out an accord on a handover of most of Hebron to Palestinian rule.

Earlier Ross told reporters work remained to conclude the deal. "There is work going on. There is still a lot of work to be done," Ross said. The U.S. envoy, who has shuttled between Israel, Gaza and Egypt, arrived in the region on Saturday.
Israeli and Palestinian officials have said they were edging closer to an accord on Hebron with agreement having been reached on some major disputed points.
